ui.privacyCommercial: Frizzi never sells personal data or email addresses and never uses them for advertising, marketing or any other commercial purpose.
ui.privacyUse: We use the information you provide to organize the event, collect availability, send related emails and protect the service from abuse. Anyone with the event link can see participants’ names and availability. Email addresses stay private.
ui.privacyCookies: Frizzi does not use tracking cookies. Your language choice is saved only in your browser’s local storage.
ui.privacyRetention: We automatically delete event data, including names, email addresses and votes, from the active database and email queue at the end of the tenth day after the event date. If no date was confirmed, we use the last proposed date. Emails already received stay in recipients’ inboxes.
ui.privacyTelemetry: To fix issues and improve Frizzi, we keep technical logs and aggregate counts of selected interactions for up to 10 days.
ui.privacyProviders: We use Resend to send emails and Geoapify to look up addresses and venues. Gemini may draft an invitation line using only the recipients’ languages, without receiving names, email addresses or event details.
